question: Where is restaurant found within 20 kilometers along the way to Umstead State Park, Cary, NC from Southern National Motorsport Park, Lucama, NC?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Southern National Motorsport Park%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Umstead State Park%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 20000 -- 20 kilometers );
